story.iWant: to select voice personas to influence the tone and style of generated posts
story.soThat: my content matches my brand personality
story.tasks: - Task 1: Define voice persona data structure (AC: 2) - Task 2: Add persona state to aiStore (AC: 7) - Task 3: Create multi-select persona dropdown component (AC: 1, 8) - Task 4: Implement selected personas display (AC: 3, 4) - Task 5: Implement persona blending prompt logic (AC: 5) - Task 6: Create persona descriptions for prompts (AC: 5) - Task 7: Integrate persona selector into Generation Panel (AC: 1) - Task 8: Add persona blending to content generation (AC: 5) - Task 9: Handle edge cases and validation (AC: 6) - Task 10: Add UI enhancements (Optional) - Task 11: Write unit tests for persona blending logic (Testing) - Task 12: Write component tests for PersonaSelector (Testing)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Multi-select dropdown implemented with shadcn/ui Select component 2. Dropdown includes 12+ voice personas across Business/Tech, Creative/Humor, Professional categories 3. Users can select multiple personas (style blending) 4. Selected personas shown as tags/chips with remove option 5. System prompt generator blends selected personas into unified style instructions 6. Default state: No personas selected (neutral/professional tone) 7. Persona selection persists across session 8. Dropdown searchable/filterable for easy selection

docs.doc: Defines Voice Personas with 12+ personas (Naval, Elon, Gary Vee, Tim Ferriss, Scott Adams, Seth Godin, Casey Neistat, MKBHD, Simon Sinek, Brené Brown, Adam Grant, Malcolm Gladwell).
Specifies GenerationPanel.tsx integration for persona selection and blending into system prompts.

package.name: @radix-ui/react-select
package.reason: shadcn/ui Select component for multi-select dropdown (already installed)

package.name: lucide-react
package.reason: Icons for chips and UI elements

story-context.constraints: - Persona Data: Define VoicePersona interface with id, name, category, description fields - Multi-Select: Use shadcn/ui Select/Combobox with custom multi-select logic - Prompt Building: Main process utility blends persona styles into system prompts (1 persona → single style, multiple → blended) - State Persistence: Selected personas persist within session via aiStore - Limit: Recommend max 3-4 personas, warn if >3, hard limit at 5 - Default: Empty array (no personas, neutral tone) - Categories: Business/Tech, Creative/Humor, Professional

interface.name: VoicePersona
interface.signature: { id: string; name: string; category: 'business' | 'creative' | 'professional'; description: string }

interfaces.interface: Defines persona data structure with style description for prompts
Blends selected personas into unified style instruction for system prompts
Array of selected persona IDs for style blending

tests.standards: Unit tests for persona blending logic (0, 1, multiple personas). Component tests for PersonaSelector UI and multi-select behavior. Test search/filter functionality. Test state binding to aiStore.
tests.ideas: - AC 1: Test multi-select dropdown renders with shadcn/ui Select - AC 2: Test all 12+ personas displayed in dropdown, grouped by category - AC 3, 4: Test adding/removing personas, chips/badges display - AC 5: Test buildPersonaPrompt blends styles (single vs multiple personas) - AC 6: Test default state (empty array, neutral tone) - AC 7: Test selectedPersonas persists in aiStore - AC 8: Test search/filter functionality filters personas by name - Edge cases: Max 5 personas, warn at >3
